definitions: The act or process of changing the way a story, situation, or set of facts is presented or understood, often to alter perception or meaning.
A strategic communication technique used to shift the perspective or interpretation of an event, issue, or person.
examples: Reframing the narrative around mental health has reduced stigma.
The campaign focused on reframing the narrative of the company's past failures.
Reframing the narrative can empower marginalized communities.
